entry.title: I made a portfolio, Please clap 🙃
entry.summary:
Yes. I finally did the thing. After days of battling Tailwind, fighting my inner perfectionist, and Googling "how to center a div" for the 87th time — I built my second personal portfolio. Live here 👈
Why tho?
Honestly? I wanted to look serious online. I was tired of my GitHub being the only "proof of existence". I Already have one portfolio but not to good, You can see my Old Portfolio. And let’s be real… I just wanted something to drop in job applications that wasn’t a Notion page 😬. This portfolio isn’t just HTML and vibes. Here's the tech stack I used (because devs love lists): Next.js 15 React 19 Tailwind CSS (with tailwind-merge) Framer Motion & motion for smooth animation Dark mode support via next-themes
🧠 Forms & Validation
react-hook-form + @hookform/resolvers
Schema validation with zod
🧩 Radix UI Components
I may have used almost every component Radix ever made: Accordion, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Tabs, Tooltip, Checkbox, Select, Label, Avatar, Collapsible, Separator, Slot, AspectRatio cmdk for command menu clsx & class-variance-authority for conditional classes lucide-react for icons react-markdown for content rendering nodemailer (for future email stuff) @vercel/analytics to spy on myself Star it in Github ⭐
I need you (for feedback, not money… yet)
This thing is still a baby.
So if you visit and think: “huh, that section is weird”
or
“why would anyone use that font?” The design is truly inspired by Tailwindcss.com and Shadcnui
Please tell me. Rip it apart if needed. I want to improve it. It’s open source, MIT licensed. Fork it. Clone it. Remix it.
Just don’t forget to leave a star ⭐ (I need the dopamine). Source Code 🔥
Follow me maybe?
If you like what I build (or just enjoy watching devs overshare online),
consider following me on GitHub! Follow me in Github
That’s it
I made a portfolio. Please clap.
And if you do clap, maybe leave a comment too 👇 Peace ✌️
— Taqui
